institution: Northwest Community College, British Columbia, Canada
method: Direct extraction of existing PDF vector paths; no raster tracing or redrawing. Cropped canvas and removed unrelated page content. Source clipping and duplicate overprinted letter paths retained.
colour_note: RGB values as stored in the 2025 magazine reproduction. These are not independently verified Pantone or historical brand standards.
dating_note: The 2025 timeline places the logo beside the 1975 founding entry; that does not date the introduction of this exact lockup. The 2015 sheet independently documents the emblem-and-wordmark layout before the 2018 renaming.
